name: opengym-admin
description: OpenGym Admin — Fitness Platform Management Dashboard

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "NEXT,ELECTRON" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env IS_DEV=true electron electron-dist/main.js"
scripts.electron:start: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && cross-env IS_DEV=false electron electron-dist/main.js
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.electron:build:dir: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
